entities.summary: Franciszek Ksawery Liske was a Polish historian, a founder of the Lwów's historical school, a founder and first chairman of the Polish Historical Society, director of the Archiwum Krajowe Aktów Grodzkich i Ziemskich we Lwowie. In 1879-1880 he was Rector of the Lviv University.
